asr.full_text: Hey there, crypto enthusiasts. This is Yevgeny Radenko and today, we've got a hot batch of news from the world of cryptocurrencies and financial technologies. Let's dive in. In the first year of Spot Bitcoin ETFs in the U.S., 12 issuers accumulated 1.13 million bitcoins worth $106.6 billion. This represents 5.4% of the total coin supply. Edith from Blackrock became the market leader with assets of $52.7 billion, surpassing Grayscale's GBTC. Fidelity analysts note that the launch of Spot ETFs has reduced their mining profitability- accumulating five percent of Bitcoin's market supply. New protocols like Runes and Ordinals failed to compensate for this revenue decline. Experts suggest companies will need to seek regions with cheaper electricity, though they don't foresee any threat to network security. On January 11th, hackers took control of litecoin's official x account to promote a fake solana based token the team quickly restored control by removing delegated access similar attacks affected cardano foundation and eigen layer raising concerns about platform security according to glassnode half of bitcoin network liquidity now belongs to new investors holding coins for less than three months. Experienced investors are gradually selling assets, but new demand successfully compensates for this pressure. Analysts predict a local price peak in the second quarter of this year. New York's attorney general filed a lawsuit to recover 2 million dollars in cryptocurrency stolen from State Residents. Scammers offered fake remote work, forcing victims to open crypto accounts and deposit funds for writing fake reviews. The U.S. Secret Service managed to free some of the stolen assets. That's the news for today, folks. The world of cryptocurrencies continues to surprise and evolve every day. Stay with us and you'll always be in the know about the hottest events. I would be happy to see you on my social media! Links are below the video. Subscribe and stay updated on all the news.
